notes.text: PARKED by the user at the comp gate. This session has no image-generation tool, so the three compositional comps could not be produced; the user chose to wait rather than downgrade to code-led. What is already built and staying: the token world (navy ground, accent hue 213), the accent-contrast fix, and the conversation-row/search/composer shapes. No further restyling until three comps of the chosen direction (seed 8341d9bd) exist under .impeccable/mocks with sidecars and one is approved. Direction contract: apps/desktop/.impeccable/surfaces/apps-desktop-src.md

reasons: 0 comps under .impeccable\mocks; the comp round puts three compositional options of the chosen direction in front of the user (reference/visualize.md). Generate the missing ones (harness image tool or generate-image.mjs), each with a .json sidecar holding its prompt.

no comp is approved: put the three comps in front of the user (decision page via serve-question.mjs, or the structured question tool), then set "approved": true in the chosen comp's sidecar. A delegated pick is recorded the same way and disclosed.
